rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for how simple, uncomplicated, or straightforward something is.

example.english: The simplicity of this tutorial is just right; you understand it after reading it once.
example.traditional: 呢個教學嘅簡單程度啱啱好，睇一次就明。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaau3 hok6 ge3 gaan2 daan1 cing4 dou6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 tai2 jat1 ci3 zau6 ming4

rows.note: Use this for simplicity as a minimalist or unornamented style, especially in design, clothing, or lifestyle contexts.

example.english: The simplicity of this home's design looks comfortable and stylish.
example.traditional: 呢間屋走簡約路線，睇落又舒服又有格調。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 uk1 zau2 gaan2 joek3 lou6 sin3 tai2 lok6 jau6 syu1 fuk6 jau6 jau5 gaak3 diu6

rows.note: Use this when simplicity means ease of use or practical efficiency rather than few parts or plain style.

example.english: The simplicity of this self-service payment machine is great; you only need to tap a few times.
example.traditional: 呢部自助付款機嘅方便程度好高，撳幾下就搞掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 zi6 zo6 fu6 fun2 gei1 ge3 fong1 bin6 cing4 dou6 hou2 gou1 gam6 gei2 haa5 zau6 gaau2 dim6
